response: ["Dermatoscopy shall be used for assessment of pigmented and non-pigmented skin lesions. (Recommendation 4)","Whole-body photography with sequential examinations should be used for early detection of melanoma in high-risk patients. (Recommendation 5)","Sequential digital dermatoscopy can improve early detection of melanoma and should be used in high-risk patients with high total nevus count. (Recommendation 6)","The 7-point score includes the criteria blue_whitish_veil, streaks, and dots_and_globules.","Blue_whitish_veil present gives 2 points and is a major criterion.","Streaks irregular gives 1 point and is a minor criterion.","Dots_and_globules irregular gives 1 point and is a minor criterion.","These three criteria account for all 4 points of the 7-point score.","Presence of blue-whitish veil is particularly significant as a major criterion.","The lesion should show confluent blue pigment with an overlying white haze (blue-whitish veil).","The lesion should show unevenly distributed radial lines or pseudopods (irregular streaks).","The lesion should show varied size and uneven distribution of dots/globules (irregular dots_and_globules)."]
